name: save_specimen
title: Save a prompt to the user's shelf
description: Saves a prompt to the user's Meerkat shelf so it shows up at getmeerkat.dev/workspace. Use this for explicit save requests on prompts that already exist in the conversation. For new prompts the user wants Meerkat to help build, prefer chat_with_meerkat — it auto-saves the conversation. Returns the saved prompt id and a link.

prompt.description: The full prompt text to save. Save it verbatim — don't summarize.

title.description: Optional. Short title for the shelf entry (3–8 words). If omitted, Meerkat derives one from the prompt body.

project_id.description: Optional. File this prompt into a project folder. Get the id from list_projects.

notes.description: Optional. Free-form notes attached to the row's metadata.
